notes.title: Hotfix v1.2b
notes.content:
Hey everyone, as part of the Early Access, we'll let you know as much as we can of the issues we fix & improvements we make in TM21. Know that significant updates are scheduled every 3 weeks. In between these, we may release a few hotfixes like this one to quickly correct a few things.
Here is Hotfix v1.2b
It should be downloaded automatically, but if you’re having any issue, we’d recommend restarting Steam.

Again, thanks to all who help us improve the game with your feedback - we'll keep working hard to improve TM21! Make sure you join our Discord if you want us to assist with bugs & issues: https://discord.gg/fenRf7nTKc

---------------------------

Additions:
	Language : German


Fixes:
         Improved save compatibility - should avoid save compatibility issues with previous version. (Note that we cannot guarantee it will work if you have added mods)

	Culture to language error - should avoid errors when starting a new game on devices with a country that is different from the country of origin of the language (e.g.: French (Belgium), English (Canada), etc.)

Cheers!

notes.title: Tennis Manager 2021 - PATCH 1.2
notes.content:
Content of PATCH 1.2
Adds
  Languages : Spanish, Italian 
  Double ranking Pro & Junior in Player Overview when player is playing on 2 circuits 
  Mental state during matches: Tooltip to see all a detailed mental state

Inbox : 
  New function for Inbox : select all, delete, mark as read, new category filter ‘my player’ 
  Tutorial for Shape* 
   ~15 new hazards* 
  Tournament invitation : add week n° and "Q" as Qualifying when applicable 

Modification & Tuning
  Hazard mails frequencies & triggering* 
  Improve Calendar system for future updates 

Staff : 
  Update info & photo* 
  Less staff will want to retire at the beginning of the game* 

Players updates: 
  Hair & skin colors* 
  Equipment colors & contracts* 
  Notoriety & Wonderkid bonus (juniors)* 
  Player retirement chances according to ranking drop & age* 
  New real players* 

Match : 
  New tutorial 
  Improvements on initial mental state & player talk 
  Changed default settings for Highlights 

Known bugs
  Impossible to get injured in training
  Player denied for qualifications despite having necessary rank
  18-year-old player entering the MTL circuit but denied access to every tournament
  Player serves from the wrong side

Fixes
 Match & Co : 
  Game plan selection on Briefing screen 
  Hide useless option in menu TM 
  Mental state display in player talk (during match) 
  Mental state: motivation update on set lost according to intensity levels 
  When normal speed in match is set to x1.3 or x1.6, 2nd serve animation was not always played (the 
  player stays in idle position but the ball is launched without serve animation)

notes.title: Tennis Manager 2021 - Patch 1.2 - June 8 2021
notes.content:
Our next patch will launch on June 8, here are all the assets and features that will be added and improved in TM21:
New languages: Spanish, Italian & German.
Community vote:  Improvements of player’s in-match attitude (position on the court, volleys, smashs and more…).
Community vote: New special content/hazards inside the academy (eg: 2 players don’t get along).

Adds:
Women Grand Slam matches and Grand Slam qualifications now in best of 3 sets

Modification & Tuning:
Hazard mail frequencies
Changed default settings for higlights (see settings in Match)  Now they are all checked (except Never)
Improve Calendar system for future updates

Fixes:
Fixed button Apply state in Game Settings when sound volume is changed
Fix game plan section on Briefing screen
Junior race ranking
London is no more in Canada
Several text issues
Ranking was present on profile of a retired player
Some countries can crash if chosen in academy creation
“Refused” sometimes displayed in the list after a successful negotiation with staff
Inconsistence between mail and objectives interface for the objective “Reach 70% completion of the minimum objectives…”
When normal speed in match is set to x1.3 or x1.6, 2nd serve animation was not always played (the player stays in idle position but the ball is launched without serve animation) 
Remove 19-year-old players from display in Junior race ranking 
Fix accessories colors on 2 hair cuts 
Fix 3D models for 3 equipements 
Fixed qualification round name in all screens and mails 
And more corrections

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.d
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix v1.1.d[/b]

Hey everyone, as part of the Early Access, we'll let you know as much as we can of the issues we fix & improvements we make in TM21. Know that significant updates are scheduled every 3 weeks. In between these, we may release a few hotfixes like this one to quickly correct a few things. 
Here is Hotfix v1.1.d
It should be downloaded automatically, but if you’re having any issue, we’d recommend restarting Steam.

Again, thanks to all who help us improve the game with your feedback - we'll keep working hard to improve TM21! 

---------------------------

   Contracts clauses are now based on season age
